notes: TBox expansion paired with history-replace-0008 (ancient Egyptian obelisk: a single block -> stacked blocks). Keeps the relation built_from and the new object stacked blocks; the subject is a made-up class (the obelisks of an invented Egyptian town, Ta-Wenesh) under the real class of ancient Egyptian obelisks. Derived queries work out what follows from the construction (not a monolith, joints, can be dismantled); each needs the edit plus one real bridge fact held by the models. The near query asks about the Lateran Obelisk, a real monolith: a method that over-applies the rule would answer several blocks.
